name: Lady Jacinta
source:
A powerful Mage and former member of the Enclave's Mage Council. Her fall from grace is a secret outside of the Enclave. [url=https://vndb.org/c165583]The Queen[/url] and Jacinta have been friends for two decades, which hasn't prevented Jacinta having feelings for the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url]. Jacinta uses her sex magic abilities to appeal to the MC.
